Privacy

Privacy is built in — you never have to do a privacy step.

Faces are auto-blurred
Every photo is screened at upload. If a face might survive the blur, the photo is quarantined — the verdicts publish, the photo doesn't.
GPS is stripped at upload
Photos carry no location metadata. Pins come from the place you chose, not your camera.
Guest choices stay on this device
Browsing never needs a login. Signing in only adds sync — it never adds tracking.
